blocks.raw: Earned promotions are promotions that customers receive after meeting specific criteria or completing certain activities defined by a brand, such as making a purchase, registering, updating their profile, or achieving a milestone. This fact table captures information related to earned promotions, such as the date and time the promotion was earned, the customer ID associated with it, etc.
